text: そうか……　しょうぶ　せんのか……　そうか　そうか　……　まあ　きが　むいたら　また　きておくれ

structure.jp: しょうぶ　せんのか……

patterns.name: 〜ない
patterns.explanation: せん is the old-man and dialect form of しない: ん stands in for ない, 'not'. しょうぶ　せん = 'you won't battle'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'once' that happens. きが　むいたら = 'if you feel like it'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form means someone does a thing as a favor to the speaker. おくれ is an old, gentle way of asking for that favor. きておくれ = 'please come, for me'.
